| `realm` | string | No       | Domain name. Absent or empty restores the default. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                    |
| ----- | ------------------------------ |
| `404` | The application is not routed. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "realm": "epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "application": "cx",
        "realm": "epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "destination_realm": "epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "peers": [
            {
                "id": "01a1796b-90b3-74bc-b148-bdc28999206e",
                "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "priority": 10,
                "status": {
                    "state": "down",
                    "since": "2026-10-26T18:14:14.963Z",
                    "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                    "error": "tcp: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:0->127.0.0.1:3869: connect: connection refused"
                }
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

# Initialize

## Initialize Ella IMS

This path creates the first user, an Admin, and logs it in.

| Method | Path           |
| ------ | -------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/init` |

### Request Body

| Field      | Type   | Required | Description    |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | -------------- |
| `email`    | string | Yes      | Email address. |
| `password` | string | Yes      | 8 to 72 bytes. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `201` | Created.                                   |
| `403` | A user exists.                             |
| `429` | Too many attempts from the client address. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "email": "admin@example.com",
    "password": "correct horse"
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "message": "System initialized successfully",
        "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
    }
}
```

# IP-SM-GW

The IP-SM-GW is Ella IMS's built-in IP Short Message Gateway: the Application Server that carries SMS over IP.

## Get the IP-SM-GW

This path returns the IP-SM-GW settings and name.

| Method | Path               |
| ------ | ------------------ |
| GET    | `/api/v1/ip-sm-gw` |

### Response Fields

| Field    | Type   | Description                                                                               |
| -------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `number` | string | E.164 number of the IP-SM-GW, without `+`. Empty if not set.                              |
| `name`   | string | SIP URI of the IP-SM-GW, the server name of its iFCs. Derived from the operator settings. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "number": "15550000100",
        "name": "sip:ipsmgw.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
    }
}
```

## Update the IP-SM-GW

This path sets the IP-SM-GW number. The IP-SM-GW registers the new number at the HSS for the users it serves. An empty number deregisters it.

| Method | Path               |
| ------ | ------------------ |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/ip-sm-gw` |

### Request Body

| Field    | Type   | Required | Description                                            |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `number` | string | Yes      | E.164 number of 1 to 15 digits, without `+`, or empty. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "number": "15550000100"
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "number": "15550000100",
        "name": "sip:ipsmgw.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
    }
}
```

# MCPTT Groups

An MCPTT group is a prearranged group (TS 24.481 §7.2) whose calls use AMR-WB. The `/api/v1/mcptt` paths answer `404` when the IMS does not run the MCPTT AS.

## List Groups

This path returns the list of groups, in the order they were created in.

| Method | Path                   |
| ------ | ---------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description               |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.       |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page. |

### Response Fields

| Field                            | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                                   |
| -------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `group_id`                       | string  | Group ID.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `display_name`                   | string  | Group name (TS 24.481 §7.2.2). Empty if none.                                                                                                                                 |
| `hang_timer_ms`                  | int     | How long a call lasts without anyone talking, T4 (TS 24.380 Table 11.1.3-1). `0` releases the call as soon as the floor is idle. Absent if not set, in which case it is 30 s. |
| `maximum_duration_ms`            | int     | How long a call lasts at most, TNG3 (TS 24.379 §6.3.3.5).                                                                                                                     |
| `release_on_initiator_leave`     | boolean | Whether a call ends when the member that started it leaves (TS 24.379 §6.3.8.1).                                                                                              |
| `members`                        | array   | Members of the group.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `members[].mcptt_id`             | string  | MCPTT ID of the member.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `members[].recvonly`             | boolean | Whether the member may listen but not talk.                                                                                                                                   |
| `members[].implicit_affiliation` | boolean | Whether the group is one of the member's `implicit_affiliations`.                                                                                                             |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
                "display_name": "Fire",
                "maximum_duration_ms": 300000,
                "release_on_initiator_leave": false,
                "members": [
                    {
                        "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                        "recvonly": false,
                        "implicit_affiliation": true
                    }
                ]
            },
            {
                "group_id": "sip:police@mcptt.example.com",
                "display_name": "Police",
                "hang_timer_ms": 10000,
                "maximum_duration_ms": 600000,
                "release_on_initiator_leave": true,
                "members": [
                    {
                        "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                        "recvonly": false,
                        "implicit_affiliation": false
                    },
                    {
                        "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
                        "recvonly": false,
                        "implicit_affiliation": true
                    }
                ]
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 2
    }
}
```

## Get a Group

This path returns the details of a specific group.

| Method | Path                              |
| ------ | --------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups/{group_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description                                         |
| ---------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `group_id` | string | Group ID, for example `sip:fire@mcptt.example.com`. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                 |
| ----- | --------------------------- |
| `404` | No group has this group ID. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "group_id": "sip:police@mcptt.example.com",
        "display_name": "Police",
        "hang_timer_ms": 10000,
        "maximum_duration_ms": 600000,
        "release_on_initiator_leave": true,
        "members": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": false
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Create a Group

This path creates a group.

| Method | Path                   |
| ------ | ---------------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups` |

### Request Body

| Field                            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                              |
| -------------------------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `group_id`                       | string  | Yes      | SIP URI. Unique among users and groups.                                                                  |
| `display_name`                   | string  | No       | Up to 64 characters.                                                                                     |
| `hang_timer_ms`                  | int     | No       |                                                                                                          |
| `maximum_duration_ms`            | int     | Yes      | At least 1.                                                                                              |
| `release_on_initiator_leave`     | boolean | No       | Default `false`.                                                                                         |
| `members`                        | array   | No       |                                                                                                          |
| `members[].mcptt_id`             | string  | Yes      | MCPTT ID of a user.                                                                                      |
| `members[].recvonly`             | boolean | No       | Default `false`.                                                                                         |
| `members[].implicit_affiliation` | boolean | No       | Adds the group to, or removes it from, the user's `implicit_affiliations`. Absent leaves them unchanged. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                            |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `409` | The request conflicts with other users or groups, such as a member that is not a user. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
    "display_name": "Fire",
    "maximum_duration_ms": 300000,
    "members": [
        {
            "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
            "implicit_affiliation": true
        },
        {
            "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
            "recvonly": true
        }
    ]
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
        "display_name": "Fire",
        "maximum_duration_ms": 300000,
        "release_on_initiator_leave": false,
        "members": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": true,
                "implicit_affiliation": false
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Update a Group

This path replaces a group, members included. The request body is that of [Create a Group](#create-a-group); `group_id` is optional and, if present, must be that of the path. A member removed loses the group from its `implicit_affiliations`.

| Method | Path                              |
| ------ | --------------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups/{group_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description |
| ---------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `group_id` | string | Group ID.   |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                            |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No group has this group ID.                                                            |
| `409` | The request conflicts with other users or groups, such as a member that is not a user. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "display_name": "Police",
    "hang_timer_ms": 10000,
    "maximum_duration_ms": 600000,
    "release_on_initiator_leave": true,
    "members": [
        {
            "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com"
        },
        {
            "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
            "implicit_affiliation": true
        }
    ]
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "group_id": "sip:police@mcptt.example.com",
        "display_name": "Police",
        "hang_timer_ms": 10000,
        "maximum_duration_ms": 600000,
        "release_on_initiator_leave": true,
        "members": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": false
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Delete a Group

This path deletes a group. The group leaves the `implicit_affiliations` of its users, its affiliations are removed, and its call, if any, is released.

| Method | Path                              |
| ------ | --------------------------------- |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups/{group_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description |
| ---------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `group_id` | string | Group ID.   |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                 |
| ----- | --------------------------- |
| `404` | No group has this group ID. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "message": "group deleted"
    }
}
```

## Add or Replace a Member

This path adds a user to the members of a group, after the others, or replaces the member where it is. It returns the group.

| Method | Path                                                 |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups/{group_id}/members/{mcptt_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description           |
| ---------- | ------ | --------------------- |
| `group_id` | string | Group ID.             |
| `mcptt_id` | string | MCPTT ID of the user. |

### Request Body

| Field                  | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id`             | string  | No       | Must be that of the path.                                                                                |
| `recvonly`             | boolean | No       | Default `false`.                                                                                         |
| `implicit_affiliation` | boolean | No       | Adds the group to, or removes it from, the user's `implicit_affiliations`. Absent leaves them unchanged. |

The body is required; `{}` takes the defaults.

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                 |
| ----- | --------------------------- |
| `200` | The member was replaced.    |
| `201` | The member was added.       |
| `404` | No group has this group ID. |
| `409` | The user does not exist.    |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "recvonly": false,
    "implicit_affiliation": true
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
        "display_name": "Fire",
        "maximum_duration_ms": 300000,
        "release_on_initiator_leave": false,
        "members": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Remove a Member

This path removes a user from the members of a group. The group leaves the user's `implicit_affiliations`, and the user's clients are de-affiliated from it and leave its call, if any. It returns the group.

| Method | Path                                                 |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/mcptt/groups/{group_id}/members/{mcptt_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description             |
| ---------- | ------ | ----------------------- |
| `group_id` | string | Group ID.               |
| `mcptt_id` | string | MCPTT ID of the member. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                              |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No group has this group ID, or the user is not a member. |
| `409` | The group would be invalid without the member.           |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
        "display_name": "Fire",
        "maximum_duration_ms": 300000,
        "release_on_initiator_leave": false,
        "members": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "recvonly": false,
                "implicit_affiliation": true
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

# MCPTT Live State

The registrations, affiliations and group calls the MCPTT AS holds in memory. The `/api/v1/mcptt` paths answer `404` when the IMS does not run the MCPTT AS.

## List Registrations

This path returns the list of MCPTT clients bound to their users by service authorisation, ordered by MCPTT ID and client ID.

| Method | Path                          |
| ------ | ----------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/registrations` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description               |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | query | str  |         |         | Filter by MCPTT ID.       |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.       |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page. |

### Response Fields

| Field        | Type   | Description                                                                    |
| ------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `mcptt_id`   | string | MCPTT ID of the user.                                                          |
| `client_id`  | string | MCPTT client ID (TS 24.379 §4.10).                                             |
| `impu`       | string | IMS public user identity the client registered at.                             |
| `impus`      | array  | Public user identities the client is served at, `impu` first.                  |
| `since`      | string | When the client was authorised for the user (RFC 3339). Kept across refreshes. |
| `expires_at` | string | Expiry time (RFC 3339).                                                        |
| `contacts`   | array  | Contacts the client registered, in direct mode. Empty through the IMS.         |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                         |
| ----- | ----------------------------------- |
| `503` | The MCPTT AS is restarting or busy. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "client_id": "urn:uuid:00000000-0000-1000-8000-000000000001",
                "impu": "sip:15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "impus": [
                    "sip:15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                    "tel:+15550000001"
                ],
                "since": "2026-10-26T18:40:02.118Z",
                "expires_at": "2026-10-26T19:40:02.118Z",
                "contacts": []
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 1
    }
}
```

## List Affiliations

This path returns the list of affiliations of clients to groups, ordered by group ID, MCPTT ID and client ID.

| Method | Path                         |
| ------ | ---------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/affiliations` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description               |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | query | str  |         |         | Filter by MCPTT ID.       |
| `group_id` | query | str  |         |         | Filter by group ID.       |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.       |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page. |

### Response Fields

| Field       | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id`  | string  | MCPTT ID of the user.                                                                                                                                             |
| `client_id` | string  | MCPTT client ID.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `group_id`  | string  | Group ID.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `status`    | string  | Affiliation status at the participating function (TS 24.379 §9.2.2.2.2): `affiliating`, `affiliated` or `deaffiliating`. The first two count as affiliated.       |
| `implicit`  | boolean | `true` if the server affiliated the client from the user's `implicit_affiliations` (TS 24.379 §9.2.2.2.15); `false` if the client affiliated itself (§9.2.2.2.3). |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                         |
| ----- | ----------------------------------- |
| `503` | The MCPTT AS is restarting or busy. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "client_id": "urn:uuid:00000000-0000-1000-8000-000000000001",
                "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
                "status": "affiliated",
                "implicit": true
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 1
    }
}
```

## List Group Calls

This path returns the list of group calls, oldest first.

| Method | Path                  |
| ------ | --------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/calls` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description                     |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | query | str  |         |         | Filter by participant MCPTT ID. |
| `group_id` | query | str  |         |         | Filter by group ID.             |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.             |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page.       |

### Response Fields

| Field                     | Type    | Description                                                                               |
| ------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                      | string  | Call identifier, the "gr" of the MCPTT session identity.                                  |
| `session_id`              | string  | MCPTT session identity (TS 24.379 §4.5).                                                  |
| `group_id`                | string  | Group ID.                                                                                 |
| `originator`              | string  | MCPTT ID of the member that started the call.                                             |
| `created_at`              | string  | Creation time (RFC 3339).                                                                 |
| `started_at`              | string  | When the originator was answered (RFC 3339). `null` while the call is set up.             |
| `ends_at`                 | string  | When the maximum duration (TNG3) releases the call (RFC 3339). `null` if none.            |
| `talker`                  | object  | Participant with the floor, with its `mcptt_id` and `since`. `null` if the floor is idle. |
| `participants`            | array   | Members invited and joined, the originator first.                                         |
| `participants[].mcptt_id` | string  | MCPTT ID of the participant.                                                              |
| `participants[].state`    | string  | `invited` or `joined`.                                                                    |
| `participants[].required` | boolean | Whether the participant is required.                                                      |
| `participants[].recvonly` | boolean | Whether the participant may listen but not talk.                                          |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                         |
| ----- | ----------------------------------- |
| `503` | The MCPTT AS is restarting or busy. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "XBDRKQ5VJ7T4M2N6P3HYWLC7AE",
                "session_id": "sip:mcptt-controlling@mcptt.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org;gr=XBDRKQ5VJ7T4M2N6P3HYWLC7AE",
                "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
                "originator": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "created_at": "2026-10-26T18:45:10.402Z",
                "started_at": "2026-10-26T18:45:10.655Z",
                "ends_at": "2026-10-26T18:50:10.655Z",
                "talker": {
                    "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                    "since": "2026-10-26T18:45:11.020Z"
                },
                "participants": [
                    {
                        "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                        "state": "joined",
                        "required": false,
                        "recvonly": false
                    },
                    {
                        "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                        "state": "invited",
                        "required": false,
                        "recvonly": true
                    }
                ]
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 1
    }
}
```

## Get a Group Call

This path returns a specific group call.

| Method | Path                            |
| ------ | ------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/calls/{call_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name      | Type   | Description      |
| --------- | ------ | ---------------- |
| `call_id` | string | Call identifier. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                         |
| ----- | ----------------------------------- |
| `404` | No call has this identifier.        |
| `503` | The MCPTT AS is restarting or busy. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "id": "XBDRKQ5VJ7T4M2N6P3HYWLC7AE",
        "session_id": "sip:mcptt-controlling@mcptt.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org;gr=XBDRKQ5VJ7T4M2N6P3HYWLC7AE",
        "group_id": "sip:fire@mcptt.example.com",
        "originator": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
        "created_at": "2026-10-26T18:45:10.402Z",
        "started_at": "2026-10-26T18:45:10.655Z",
        "ends_at": "2026-10-26T18:50:10.655Z",
        "talker": null,
        "participants": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "state": "joined",
                "required": false,
                "recvonly": false
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "state": "joined",
                "required": false,
                "recvonly": true
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

# MCPTT Service Configuration

The service configuration of the MCPTT organisation (TS 24.484 §8.4). The `/api/v1/mcptt` paths answer `404` when the IMS does not run the MCPTT AS.

## Get the Status of the MCPTT AS

This path returns what the MCPTT AS runs.

| Method | Path            |
| ------ | --------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt` |

### Response Fields

| Field               | Type   | Description                                             |
| ------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`              | string | `ims` or `direct`.                                      |
| `name`              | string | Server name of the AS in the iFCs of the HSS.           |
| `participating_psi` | string | Participating PSI.                                      |
| `controlling_psi`   | string | Controlling PSI.                                        |
| `sip`               | array  | SIP addresses of the AS. Sockets in `direct` mode only. |
| `media_control`     | string | Address of the floor control channels.                  |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mode": "ims",
        "name": "sip:mcptt.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "participating_psi": "sip:mcptt-participating@mcptt.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "controlling_psi": "sip:mcptt-controlling@mcptt.ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
        "sip": ["127.0.0.1:5090"],
        "media_control": "127.0.0.1:21000"
    }
}
```

## Get the Service Configuration

This path returns the service configuration.

| Method | Path                                  |
| ------ | ------------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/service-configuration` |

### Response Fields

| Field                    | Type   | Description                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------ | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `domain`                 | string | Domain of the organisation, of its MCPTT IDs and group IDs, and the IOI of its charging. The IMS home domain until set. |
| `transmit_time_limit_ms` | int    | How long a participant may talk at a time, T2 (TS 24.380 Table 11.1.3-1). Absent if not set, in which case it is 30 s.  |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "domain": "ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
    }
}
```

## Update the Service Configuration

This path replaces the service configuration.

| Method | Path                                  |
| ------ | ------------------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/mcptt/service-configuration` |

### Request Body

| Field                    | Type   | Required | Description                 |
| ------------------------ | ------ | -------- | --------------------------- |
| `domain`                 | string | Yes      | Domain of the organisation. |
| `transmit_time_limit_ms` | int    | No       | At least 1.                 |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "domain": "mcptt.example.com",
    "transmit_time_limit_ms": 30000
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "domain": "mcptt.example.com",
        "transmit_time_limit_ms": 30000
    }
}
```

# MCPTT Users

An MCPTT user (TS 24.484 §8.3) and the IMS public user identities its clients register at. The `/api/v1/mcptt` paths answer `404` when the IMS does not run the MCPTT AS.

## List Users

This path returns the list of users, in the order they were created in.

| Method | Path                  |
| ------ | --------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/users` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description               |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.       |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page. |

### Response Fields

| Field                   | Type   | Description                                                                         |
| ----------------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id`              | string | MCPTT ID of the user.                                                               |
| `alias`                 | string | Alias of the user (TS 24.484 §8.3.2.7). Empty if none.                              |
| `impus`                 | array  | IMS public user identities of the user, such as `sip:mcptt-<MSISDN>@<home domain>`. |
| `implicit_affiliations` | array  | Group IDs the user's clients are affiliated to when they register.                  |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
                "alias": "Alice",
                "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
                "implicit_affiliations": ["sip:fire@mcptt.example.com"]
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
                "alias": "Carol",
                "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000003@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
                "implicit_affiliations": ["sip:police@mcptt.example.com"]
            },
            {
                "mcptt_id": "sip:bob@mcptt.example.com",
                "alias": "Bob",
                "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000002@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
                "implicit_affiliations": []
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 3
    }
}
```

## Get a User

This path returns the details of a specific user.

| Method | Path                             |
| ------ | -------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/mcptt/users/{mcptt_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description                                                      |
| ---------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | string | MCPTT ID of the user, for example `sip:alice@mcptt.example.com`. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                |
| ----- | -------------------------- |
| `404` | No user has this MCPTT ID. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
        "alias": "Alice",
        "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
        "implicit_affiliations": ["sip:fire@mcptt.example.com"]
    }
}
```

## Create a User

This path creates a user.

| Method | Path                  |
| ------ | --------------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/mcptt/users` |

### Request Body

| Field                   | Type   | Required | Description                                  |
| ----------------------- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `mcptt_id`              | string | Yes      | SIP URI. Unique among users and groups.      |
| `alias`                 | string | No       | Up to 64 characters.                         |
| `impus`                 | array  | Yes      | At least one.                                |
| `implicit_affiliations` | array  | No       | Group IDs of groups the user is a member of. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                           |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `409` | The request conflicts with other users or groups, such as an MCPTT ID already in use. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
    "alias": "Alice",
    "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"]
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mcptt_id": "sip:alice@mcptt.example.com",
        "alias": "Alice",
        "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
        "implicit_affiliations": []
    }
}
```

## Update a User

This path replaces a user. The request body is that of [Create a User](#create-a-user); `mcptt_id` is optional and, if present, must be that of the path.

| Method | Path                             |
| ------ | -------------------------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/mcptt/users/{mcptt_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description           |
| ---------- | ------ | --------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | string | MCPTT ID of the user. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                                                                                               |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No user has this MCPTT ID.                                                                                                |
| `409` | The request conflicts with other users or groups, such as an implicit affiliation to a group the user is not a member of. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "alias": "Carol",
    "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000003@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
    "implicit_affiliations": ["sip:police@mcptt.example.com"]
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mcptt_id": "sip:carol@mcptt.example.com",
        "alias": "Carol",
        "impus": ["sip:mcptt-15550000003@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"],
        "implicit_affiliations": ["sip:police@mcptt.example.com"]
    }
}
```

## Delete a User

This path deletes a user. The user leaves its groups, and its clients are logged off and leave the group calls they are in.

| Method | Path                             |
| ------ | -------------------------------- |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/mcptt/users/{mcptt_id}` |

### Path Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description           |
| ---------- | ------ | --------------------- |
| `mcptt_id` | string | MCPTT ID of the user. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                          |
| ----- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `404` | No user has this MCPTT ID.                           |
| `409` | A group the user leaves would be invalid without it. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "message": "user deleted"
    }
}
```

# Metrics

## Get Metrics

This path returns the metrics of the IMS in the [Prometheus exposition format](https://prometheus.io/docs/instrumenting/exposition_formats/#text-format-details), negotiated from the request's `Accept` header.

| Method | Path              |
| ------ | ----------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/metrics` |

### Sample Response

```
# HELP ellaims_active_calls Calls in progress: attempted and not yet ended.
# TYPE ellaims_active_calls gauge
ellaims_active_calls 0
# HELP ellaims_calls_total Calls that ended, by outcome, as their call records show it.
# TYPE ellaims_calls_total counter
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="answered"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="busy"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="cancelled"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="failed"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="no_answer"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="rejected"} 0
ellaims_calls_total{outcome="unavailable"} 0
# HELP ellaims_database_query_errors_total Database calls that failed, by connection pool. A record not found or in conflict is a result, not a failure.
# TYPE ellaims_database_query_errors_total counter
ellaims_database_query_errors_total{pool="read"} 0
ellaims_database_query_errors_total{pool="write"} 0
# HELP ellaims_database_storage_bytes Size of the database on disk, by file: the main file and its write-ahead log.
# TYPE ellaims_database_storage_bytes gauge
ellaims_database_storage_bytes{file="main"} 4096
ellaims_database_storage_bytes{file="wal"} 646872
```

# Operator

The operator is the PLMN of the IMS, from which its home domain and Diameter identity derive, and the numbering plan that converts dial strings to E.164 numbers.

## Get the Operator

This path returns the operator settings.

| Method | Path               |
| ------ | ------------------ |
| GET    | `/api/v1/operator` |

### Response Fields

| Field                            | Type   | Description                                  |
| -------------------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------- |
| `mcc`                            | string | Mobile Country Code.                         |
| `mnc`                            | string | Mobile Network Code.                         |
| `numbering`                      | object | Conversion of dial strings to E.164 numbers. |
| `numbering.country_code`         | string | Country code.                                |
| `numbering.national_prefix`      | string | National prefix.                             |
| `numbering.international_prefix` | string | International prefix.                        |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mcc": "001",
        "mnc": "01",
        "numbering": {
            "country_code": "1",
            "national_prefix": "1",
            "international_prefix": "011"
        }
    }
}
```

## Update the Operator

This path replaces the operator settings. A change of MCC or MNC changes the home domain, and the IMS restarts Diameter and SIP under the new names.

| Method | Path               |
| ------ | ------------------ |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/operator` |

### Request Body

| Field                            | Type   | Required | Description                                                       |
| -------------------------------- | ------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mcc`                            | string | Yes      | 3 digits.                                                         |
| `mnc`                            | string | Yes      | 2 or 3 digits.                                                    |
| `numbering`                      | object | Yes      |                                                                   |
| `numbering.country_code`         | string | Yes      | 1 to 3 digits, not starting with 0.                               |
| `numbering.national_prefix`      | string | Yes      | Up to 4 digits. Differs from `international_prefix` unless empty. |
| `numbering.international_prefix` | string | Yes      | Up to 4 digits.                                                   |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "mcc": "001",
    "mnc": "01",
    "numbering": {
        "country_code": "1",
        "national_prefix": "1",
        "international_prefix": "011"
    }
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "mcc": "001",
        "mnc": "01",
        "numbering": {
            "country_code": "1",
            "national_prefix": "1",
            "international_prefix": "011"
        }
    }
}
```

# Policy

The policy function is the interface the P-CSCF uses for policy control: none, Rx to a PCRF, or N5 to a PCF.

## Get the Policy

This path returns the policy function settings and the policy function running.

| Method | Path             |
| ------ | ---------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/policy` |

### Response Fields

| Field                   | Type    | Description                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `interface`             | string  | `none`, `rx` or `n5`.                                                          |
| `n5`                    | object  | Present for the `n5` interface only.                                           |
| `n5.pcf_uri`            | string  | API root of the PCF, `http[s]://host[:port][/prefix]`.                         |
| `status`                | object  | Policy function running. Differs from the settings while the IMS applies them. |
| `status.interface`      | string  | `none`, `rx` or `n5`.                                                          |
| `status.endpoint`       | string  | `rx` for Rx; the API root of the PCF for N5.                                   |
| `status.notify`         | string  | Address of the N5 notification listener.                                       |
| `status.last`           | object  | Outcome of the last request to the PCF. N5 only.                               |
| `status.last.at`        | string  | Time of the request (RFC 3339).                                                |
| `status.last.reachable` | boolean | Whether the PCF answered.                                                      |
| `status.last.result`    | string  | Result of the request.                                                         |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "interface": "rx",
        "status": {
            "interface": "rx",
            "endpoint": "rx"
        }
    }
}
```

## Update the Policy

This path replaces the policy function settings. Calls and registrations after the change use the new policy function.

| Method | Path             |
| ------ | ---------------- |
| PUT    | `/api/v1/policy` |

### Request Body

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                  |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `interface`  | string | Yes      | `none`, `rx` or `n5`. `n5` requires `n5` in the configuration file.                                          |
| `n5`         | object | No       | For the `n5` interface only.                                                                                 |
| `n5.pcf_uri` | string | Yes      | `http[s]://host[:port][/prefix]`. `https` requires `n5.tls` in the configuration file, `http` requires none. |

### Sample Request

```
{
    "interface": "none"
}
```

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "interface": "none",
        "status": {
            "interface": "rx",
            "endpoint": "rx"
        }
    }
}
```

# Registrations

A registration is a private user identity registered with the S-CSCF, with its registered implicit registration sets.

## List Registrations

This path returns the list of registered private identities.

| Method | Path                    |
| ------ | ----------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/v1/registrations` |

### Query Parameters

| Name       | In    | Type | Default | Allowed | Description                                |
| ---------- | ----- | ---- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `search`   | query | str  |         |         | Substring of a private or public identity. |
| `page`     | query | int  | `1`     | `>= 1`  | 1-based page index.                        |
| `per_page` | query | int  | `25`    | `1…100` | Number of items per page.                  |

### Response Fields

| Field                                     | Type    | Description                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `impi`                                    | string  | Private user identity.                                                                                                       |
| `implicit_registration_sets`              | array   | Registered implicit registration sets of the private identity. A set registers and deregisters as one (TS 23.228 §5.2.1a.0). |
| `implicit_registration_sets[].hss`        | object  | Origin-Host (`host`) and Origin-Realm (`realm`) of the last Cx answer for the set. Absent while unknown.                     |
| `implicit_registration_sets[].identities` | array   | Public user identities of the set.                                                                                           |
| `identities[].uri`                        | string  | Public user identity.                                                                                                        |
| `identities[].display_name`               | string  | Display name. Absent if none.                                                                                                |
| `identities[].barred`                     | boolean | Whether the identity is barred.                                                                                              |
| `identities[].registered_with`            | array   | Other private identities a request to this public identity reaches (TS 24.229 §5.4.3.3 step 8).                              |
| `implicit_registration_sets[].contacts`   | array   | Unexpired contacts bound to the set. A contact bound to several sets is listed in each.                                      |
| `contacts[].contact`                      | string  | Contact URI.                                                                                                                 |
| `contacts[].instance`                     | string  | Instance ID, an IMEI URN when available (TS 23.003 §13.8). Absent if none.                                                   |
| `contacts[].reg_id`                       | int     | reg-id of the flow (RFC 5626). Absent if none.                                                                               |
| `contacts[].q`                            | number  | q-value (RFC 3841 §7.2.3).                                                                                                   |
| `contacts[].media`                        | array   | Media the device registered for: `audio`, `video`.                                                                           |
| `contacts[].registered_at`                | string  | Registration time (RFC 3339).                                                                                                |
| `contacts[].expires_at`                   | string  | Expiry time (RFC 3339).                                                                                                      |
| `contacts[].address`                      | string  | Address and port of the device, as seen by the P-CSCF. Absent if unknown.                                                    |
| `contacts[].transport`                    | string  | `udp` or `tcp`. Absent if unknown.                                                                                           |
| `contacts[].protected`                    | boolean | Whether IPsec protects the signalling of the device.                                                                         |
| `contacts[].signalling_path`              | string  | State of the IMS signalling path of the device: `unmonitored`, `monitored` or `lost`.                                        |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "items": [
            {
                "impi": "001010000000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                "implicit_registration_sets": [
                    {
                        "hss": {
                            "host": "hss.epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                            "realm": "epc.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
                        },
                        "identities": [
                            {
                                "uri": "sip:001010000000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org",
                                "barred": true,
                                "registered_with": []
                            },
                            {
                                "uri": "tel:+15550000001",
                                "barred": false,
                                "registered_with": []
                            }
                        ],
                        "contacts": [
                            {
                                "contact": "sip:001010000000001@10.45.0.2:5064",
                                "instance": "urn:gsma:imei:35000000-000001-0",
                                "reg_id": 1,
                                "q": 1,
                                "media": ["audio", "video"],
                                "registered_at": "2026-10-26T18:20:04.512Z",
                                "expires_at": "2026-10-26T19:20:04.512Z",
                                "address": "10.45.0.2:5064",
                                "transport": "udp",
                                "protected": true,
                                "signalling_path": "monitored"
                            }
                        ]
                    }
                ]
            }
        ],
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 25,
        "total_count": 1
    }
}
```

## Re-authenticate a Registration

This path brings forward the expiry of the bindings of a registered private identity and has its next REGISTER challenged (TS 24.229 §5.4.1.6).

| Method | Path                                          |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/registrations/{impi}/reauthenticate` |

### Path Parameters

| Name   | Type   | Description            |
| ------ | ------ | ---------------------- |
| `impi` | string | Private user identity. |

### Response Codes

| Code  | Description                                  |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `202` | Re-authentication started.                   |
| `404` | The private identity is not registered.      |
| `503` | The IMS is restarting to apply its settings. |

### Sample Response

```
{
    "result": {
        "impi": "001010000000001@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org"
    }
}
```

# Explanation

# Explanation

These explanations provide context on how Ella IMS works.

- [Architecture](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/explanation/architecture/index.md)
- [Security](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/explanation/security/index.md)
- [Push-to-Talk](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/explanation/push_to_talk/index.md)
- [SMS over IP](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/explanation/sms_over_ip/index.md)

# Architecture

Ella IMS with Ella Core

An IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) is what lets phones on a 4G or 5G network make voice and video calls. The core network gives each phone an IP connection to the IMS. Over that connection, the phone registers and places calls with SIP, and the IMS routes them.

## Three CSCFs in one process

3GPP splits the IMS's SIP routing into three Call Session Control Functions (CSCFs):

- **P-CSCF**: the phone's first contact. It protects the phone's signalling with IPsec, and asks the core network for the QoS that voice and video need.
- **I-CSCF**: the entry point of the network. It asks the HSS which S-CSCF serves a user.
- **S-CSCF**: the registrar. It authenticates phones against the HSS, routes calls, and involves Application Servers when a subscriber's filter criteria say so.

In most IMS deployments, these are separate nodes. Ella IMS runs all three in one process, with one database, one UI and one API. Each CSCF still has its own SIP port, and the three exchange standard SIP messages, in memory, so from the outside Ella IMS looks like any other IMS.

## What Ella IMS relies on

Ella IMS stores no subscribers. It relies on two functions of the core network:

- **The HSS** holds the subscribers: their identities, the keys to authenticate them, and the filter criteria that bring in Application Servers. Ella IMS reaches it over Diameter (Cx).
- **The policy function** has the core set up the dedicated bearers (4G) or QoS flows (5G) that carry voice and video. Ella IMS reaches it over Diameter (Rx), or a PCF over HTTP (N5).

Ella Core provides both. For how it works with an IMS, see Ella Core's [IMS Integration](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/core/explanation/ims_integration/).

## Standards

Ella IMS follows 3GPP standards. It should work with any compliant 4G or 5G core, Application Server and phone, beyond those it was [validated against](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/reference/supported_mobile_equipment/index.md).

# Push-to-Talk

Mission Critical Push To Talk (MCPTT) is the 3GPP standard for group calls with floor control: one member talks at a time, and the others listen. It runs as an Application Server on top of the IMS.

## A server inside the IMS

Ella IMS includes an MCPTT server, so push-to-talk needs no separate node. It runs in the same process as the CSCFs, which reach it in memory rather than over the network.

Like any Application Server, it learns about its users through the IMS. When an MCPTT user's app registers, the S-CSCF tells the MCPTT server, as the user's **MCPTT** service profile asks.

## Naming

The MCPTT server's name is `sip:mcptt.<home domain>`, and the home domain comes from the operator's MCC and MNC. Ella IMS routes every request for that host to the server, so the HSS needs no Public Service Identity for it. Changing the MCC or MNC renames the server.

## Users and groups

The HSS knows subscribers. The MCPTT server knows MCPTT users, identified by an MCPTT ID such as `alice`, and the groups they belong to. Each MCPTT user maps to the MCPTT identity of their subscriber, `sip:mcptt-<MSISDN>@<home domain>`, which is how the server ties a registered phone to a person.

The app reads the MCPTT identity from the ISIM and registers it alongside the phone's own IMS client. Both stay registered only if the phone's IMS client registers with a `reg-id`.

## Media

Unlike a regular call, a group call's voice goes through Ella IMS: its media relay receives each talker's audio and copies it to every listener. Floor control, deciding who may talk, runs on a separate control channel. That's why the MCPTT server has its own media ports.

# Security

## Authenticating phones

Phones authenticate with the keys on their SIM, with IMS-AKA, a variant of the AKA the core network uses at attach. When a phone registers, the S-CSCF fetches an authentication vector from the HSS, challenges the phone, and checks its answer. The phone checks the network in turn, so each side proves itself to the other. No password is configured on the phone or in Ella IMS.

## Protecting signalling with IPsec

The same authentication produces keys that the phone and the P-CSCF use to set up IPsec between them. From then on, the phone's SIP messages travel in ESP on dedicated ports. This protects the signalling from tampering, and ties every request to the phone that authenticated.

Ella IMS sets up these IPsec associations in the Linux kernel. That's why it needs `CAP_NET_ADMIN`, and why ESP must reach it through any firewall.

## The trust domain

SIP nodes tell each other who a request is from, for example with the P-Asserted-Identity header. A node only believes such claims from nodes it trusts: its trust domain.

Phones are never in the trust domain: the P-CSCF takes their identity from their authentication, not from what they claim. The P-CSCF trusts only Ella IMS's own addresses.

The I-CSCF and the S-CSCF also trust the networks in `sip.trusted_networks`, where other nodes such as Application Servers live. Trust goes by source address, so these networks must be protected by the operator, and must never include the phones. For the same reason, Ella IMS rejects a trusted network that covers every IPv4 or every IPv6 address.

## Users of the UI and API

Everyone who uses the UI or the API is a user with a role: Admin, Read Only or Network Manager. The role decides what the user can see and do, from reading settings to managing other users. See [Roles](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/reference/api/#roles).

The first user, an Admin, is created when Ella IMS is initialized. Admins create the others. Until then, anyone who reaches the UI can initialize Ella IMS, so initialize it as soon as it is installed.

Ella IMS limits login attempts, from each address and for each account, to slow down password guessing.

Programs, such as a monitoring system, use an API token rather than a password. A token belongs to a user and has that user's role, but it cannot create API tokens, change a password, or manage users. Tokens can expire, and an Admin or the token's user can delete one at any time.

## HTTPS

Ella IMS serves the UI and the API over plain HTTP unless it is given a certificate in `api.tls` (see the [configuration file](https://docs.ellanetworks.com/ims/reference/config_file/index.md)). Use HTTPS whenever the UI or the API is reachable over a network you do not control.

# SMS over IP

Phones on IMS can send and receive SMS as SIP MESSAGEs instead of over the 4G or 5G signalling (NAS). The IP Short Message Gateway (IP-SM-GW) is the Application Server that carries them between the phones and the SMSC.

## A server inside the IMS

Ella IMS includes an IP-SM-GW, which runs in the same process as the CSCFs. Its name is `sip:ipsmgw.<home domain>`. The HSS's filter criteria decide which subscribers it serves: without them, it receives nothing, and filter criteria naming another server bring in an external IP-SM-GW instead.

## Registration

When a phone registers, the S-CSCF tells the IP-SM-GW, which follows the phone's registration. While the phone advertises SMS over IP, the IP-SM-GW registers itself at the HSS for the subscriber. The HSS then sends the routing requests of the subscriber's incoming SMS to the IP-SM-GW. When the phone no longer advertises it, or deregisters, the IP-SM-GW deregisters too.

## Sending

The phone's SMS reaches the IP-SM-GW through the S-CSCF, and the IP-SM-GW forwards it to the SMSC of the service centre address the phone uses. The SMSC's answer goes back to the phone as a submit report. Without an SMSC, the IP-SM-GW refuses the SMS, and the phone sends it over NAS.

## Receiving

The IP-SM-GW delivers an incoming SMS over IMS first, if the phone advertises SMS over IP, then through the MME or SMSF the HSS names.
